subject.title: feat(agents): composable termination algebra + GSAR grounding scorer

question: Should OpenClaw core accept these unused termination/GSAR primitives as library-only groundwork before production sessions_send wiring and a trusted retrieved-evidence contract exist?
rationale: Repository policy keeps core lean and owner-boundary driven; this PR deliberately adds dormant core modules, so automation cannot decide whether that API surface is desirable product direction.

options.title: Repair Then Owner-Approve Library Groundwork
options.body: Fix the validation/demo defects first, then merge only after an agents/runtime owner explicitly accepts the unused core primitives as intentional groundwork.

options.title: Require Production Integration First
options.body: Ask for a narrower follow-up that wires the primitives through an owner-approved sessions_send entry point and trusted-evidence contract before adding core API surface.

options.title: Pause On The Tracker
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue open as the design discussion and close or defer this branch if dormant core API surface is not wanted now.

recommendation.title: Repair Then Owner-Approve Library Groundwork
recommendation.body: Fix the validation/demo defects first, then merge only after an agents/runtime owner explicitly accepts the unused core primitives as intentional groundwork.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is listed for Agents in CONTRIBUTING.md and was explicitly requested for review in the PR discussion, making him the best available product/API routing owner.
